# VamXRepan Baileys

This source archive is an independently maintained community fork of [WhiskeySockets/Baileys](https://github.com/WhiskeySockets/Baileys). It provides TypeScript/JavaScript WhatsApp Web socket support, ESM/CommonJS builds, and the unified `VamXRepan.Message` API.

- **Package name:** `@vamxrepan/baileys`
- **Current package version:** `1.0.0`
- **Source distribution:** the `vamxrepan-baileys-github-v1.0.0.zip` archive
- **npm distribution:** the `vamxrepan-baileys-1.0.0.tgz` tarball
- **Upstream project:** [WhiskeySockets/Baileys](https://github.com/WhiskeySockets/Baileys)

The maintainer's public GitHub repository URL has not yet been verified, so this project intentionally does not claim that the source archive is already hosted at a public fork URL. Create or select the destination repository and configure its remote before enabling GitHub releases. Likewise, publish the npm tarball only after confirming that the maintainer controls the `@vamxrepan` scope. The publish workflow expects an `NPM_TOKEN` Actions secret.

The project retains upstream attribution and the license in `LICENSE`. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta. Use it responsibly. Channel-follow automation is opt-in and never runs by default.
